body:
For example, what if we just check the main branch and conduct some focused reviews? 

@sepo-agent

comments.body:
Yes, this is feasible, but it is not just a one-line router change. Today `/review` is intentionally PR-only:

- Dispatch prompt says `review` is only valid for `pull_request`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/prompts/agent-dispatch.md#L10-L17
- `applyDispatchPolicy` rejects review requests unless `targetKind === "pull_request"`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/triage.ts#L446-L457
- `agent-router.yml` only calls `agent-review.yml` when the target is a PR: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-router.yml#L1116-L1132
- `agent-review.yml` requires `pr_number` and passes `target_kind: pull_request` into reviewer and synthesis runs: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-review.yml#L3-L42 and https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-review.yml#L220-L225
- The review prompt is diff-centered and tells reviewers to use `gh pr diff`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/prompts/review.md#L3-L12

I’d implement this as an **issue-scoped focused review mode** under the existing `review` route, keeping PR review behavior unchanged.

Plan:

1. Allow `review` on `issue` and `pull_request` in `.agent/src/triage.ts`; still reject discussions/other targets. Update triage tests that currently assert review-on-issue is unsupported.

2. Update `.github/workflows/agent-router.yml` so the review job can dispatch for issue targets too, passing `target_kind` and `target_number` instead of only `pr_number`.

3. Refactor `.github/workflows/agent-review.yml` to accept:
   - `target_kind`
   - `target_number`
   - legacy `pr_number` for workflow_dispatch compatibility

   For PRs, preserve the current path: capture PR head, run PR diff review, rubrics review, synthesis, PR comment.

   For issues, use the default branch checkout as the review subject, skip PR-head capture, skip inline PR comment management, and post the synthesis back to the issue.

4. Add or generalize prompts:
   - PR mode keeps using `gh pr view` / `gh pr diff`.
   - Issue mode reads the issue body/comments, checks out the default branch, derives a focused scope from the request, and reviews only that scope. If the issue does not contain enough scope, the review should say so instead of attempting a whole-repo audit.

5. Adjust synthesis so issue-mode review produces an issue-friendly summary and action items, with no PR inline-comment instructions.

6. Update docs in `README.md` and `.agent/docs/usage/supported-workflows.md` to say `/review` works on PRs for diff review and issues for focused default-branch review.

7. Add tests around:
   - explicit `@sepo-agent /review` on issue dispatches review
   - `agent/review` label on issue dispatches review
   - PR review route remains unchanged
   - issue review posts to issue comments and does not try PR-only inline operations

Recommended default behavior: issue `/review` should require or infer a focused scope from the issue/request. It should not silently do a whole-main-branch review unless the user explicitly asks for a broad audit.

Approve this direction and I can implement it.

---
`codex` | `gpt-5.5/xhigh` | `Macmini-runner-1`

title: Allow review routes run on issues
